hook: A map of 854,911 cells shows how the tissue around early breast cancer changes before it turns invasive.
summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing of fresh samples from 159 patients, plus spatial transcriptomics on 39 samples, covered normal breast, DCIS and invasive cancer. Fibroblasts, vascular cells and basal cells remodel around DCIS, and many changes persist into invasive disease. It covers estrogen-receptor positive DCIS only and describes changes, not causes.
title: A cellular atlas of the preinvasive breast cancer microenvironment.
